name: Shandong Linuo Pharmaceutical Packaging Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Linuo Pharmaceutical Packaging Co., Ltd. engages in the development, production, and sale of pharmaceutical and heat-resistant glass in the People's Republic of China. It offers pharmaceutical packaging products, such as glass molded injection and infusion bottle, glass ampoule, glass regulated and controlled injection, siliconized coating, healthcare bottle, oral liquid, nasal spray bottle, and glass tube.
